mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.audience_key) 'h5' AS channel, r.registration_id AS source_id, r.display_name, r.mobile_phone, COALESCE(r.contact_id, l.contact_id) AS contact_id, r.lead_id, l.status AS lead_status, l.stage AS lead_stage, r.registration_status, NULL AS wecom_external_userid, COALESCE(l.wechat_mp_openid, l.custom_field::jsonb->>'wechat_mp_openid') AS wechat_mp_openid, COALESCE(l.wechat_mp_app_id, l.custom_field::jsonb->>'wechat_mp_app_id') AS wechat_mp_app_id, NULL AS wecom_name, NULL AS mp_nickname, l.owner, NULL AS follow_userid, NULL AS raw_json, r.registered_at AS touched_at, COALESCE(r.update_time, r.registered_at) AS last_activity_at FROM crm_event_registration r LEFT JOIN crm_lead l ON l.lead_id = r.lead_id WHERE r.event_id = #{eventId} AND r.registration_source = 'h5' AND r.registration_status IN ('confirmed', 'waitlist') ORDER BY r.audience_key, r.registered_at DESC

SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.audience_key) 'website' AS channel, r.registration_id AS source_id, r.display_name, r.mobile_phone, COALESCE(r.contact_id, l.contact_id) AS contact_id, r.lead_id, l.status AS lead_status, l.stage AS lead_stage, r.registration_status, NULL AS wecom_external_userid, COALESCE(l.wechat_mp_openid, l.custom_field::jsonb->>'wechat_mp_openid') AS wechat_mp_openid, COALESCE(l.wechat_mp_app_id, l.custom_field::jsonb->>'wechat_mp_app_id') AS wechat_mp_app_id, NULL AS wecom_name, NULL AS mp_nickname, l.owner, NULL AS follow_userid, NULL AS raw_json, r.registered_at AS touched_at, COALESCE(r.update_time, r.registered_at) AS last_activity_at FROM crm_event_registration r LEFT JOIN crm_lead l ON l.lead_id = r.lead_id WHERE r.event_id = #{eventId} AND r.registration_source = 'website' AND r.registration_status IN ('confirmed', 'waitlist') ORDER BY r.audience_key, r.registered_at DESC

SELECT DISTINCT ON (w.external_userid) 'wecom' AS channel, w.external_userid AS source_id, ld.lead_name AS display_name, ld.mobile_phone, COALESCE(w.crm_contact_id, ld.contact_id) AS contact_id, COALESCE(w.crm_lead_id, ld.lead_id) AS lead_id, ld.status AS lead_status, ld.stage AS lead_stage, w.external_userid AS wecom_external_userid, NULL AS wechat_mp_openid, NULL AS wecom_name, NULL AS mp_nickname, ld.owner, w.follow_userid, w.raw_json, w.create_time AS touched_at, COALESCE(w.update_time, w.create_time) AS last_activity_at FROM crm_wecom_external_contact w LEFT JOIN crm_lead ld ON ld.lead_id = w.crm_lead_id WHERE w.crm_event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY w.external_userid, w.create_time ASC

SELECT 'mp' AS channel, agg.openid AS source_id, f.nickname AS display_name, NULL AS mobile_phone, COALESCE(agg.subject_id, f.contact_id, id_ci.contact_id) AS contact_id, NULL AS lead_id, NULL AS lead_status, NULL AS lead_stage, NULL AS wecom_external_userid, agg.openid AS wechat_mp_openid, agg.app_id AS wechat_mp_app_id, NULL AS wecom_name, f.nickname AS mp_nickname, NULL AS owner, NULL AS follow_userid, NULL AS raw_json, agg.first_touch_at AS touched_at, agg.last_activity_at FROM ( SELECT COALESCE( a.context->>'openid', a.context->>'open_id', a.payload->>'open_id', a.payload->>'openId' ) AS openid, MAX(a.context->>'app_id') AS app_id, a.subject_id, MIN(a.started_date) AS first_touch_at, MAX(COALESCE(a.update_time, a.started_date)) AS last_activity_at FROM crm_activity a WHERE a.channel = 'wechat_mp' AND a.event_type IN ('channel.wechat_mp.follow', 'channel.wechat_mp.scan') AND COALESCE( a.context->>'openid', a.context->>'open_id', a.payload->>'open_id', a.payload->>'openId' ) IS NOT NULL AND ( a.context->>'crm_event_id' = #{eventId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM crm_wechat_mp_qrcode q WHERE q.crm_event_id = #{eventId} AND ( a.context->>'qr_code_id' = q.id::text OR a.context->>'scene_str' = q.scene_str OR a.payload->>'event_key' = 'qrscene_' || q.scene_str OR a.payload->>'scene_str' = q.scene_str ) ) ) GROUP BY COALESCE( a.context->>'openid', a.context->>'open_id', a.payload->>'open_id', a.payload->>'openId' ), a.subject_id ) agg LEFT JOIN crm_wechat_mp_fan f ON f.open_id = agg.openid AND (agg.app_id IS NULL OR f.app_id = agg.app_id) LEFT JOIN crm_customer_identity id_ci ON id_ci.identity_type = 'wechat_mp_openid' AND id_ci.identity_value = agg.openid
